payload.text: **CI is vc's to read after every push (lesson, 2026-09-18).** CI was red at db05b29 on 17 Sep and nobody reported it until hv found it again at 05922e1. The local full suite can't see it: my git config supplies init.defaultBranch, and macOS supplies BSD stat. Proposed to hv: (a) after each hv push, vc reads 'gh run list' and reports; (b) test_helper pins GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL to a fixture file, so local runs stop inheriting the person's git config.
